newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks moderately stronger in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks moderately stronger in early trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened moderately higher on Monday, as the weaker yen against the dollar sparked buying in major export-oriented blue-chip firms, brokers said.
But some sectors, such as construction and securities, remained weak, trimming the market's gains.
At 0007 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average gained 77.50 points or 0.43 percent to 17,938.09. June Nikkei futures rose 70 points to 17,920.
The dollar rose on Friday overseas and was trading at 124.60/70 yen in early Tokyo trade on Monday versus 123.55 in late Tokyo trade on Friday.
